summary.intent: Execute all plans in phase 68.1 of the cipher-box project using GSD's wave-based parallel execution workflow, letting the orchestrator discover plans, analyze file-dependency overlaps, group them into waves, and spawn per-plan subagents while staying within a lean context budget.
summary.outcome: Orchestrator completed setup: loaded all execute-phase gate/reference files, ran pre-flight checks and build/test script inspection, determined no optional flags (--wave, --gaps-only, --interactive) were active for '68.1', planned 5 waves plus a final gate wave (code review, parent-artifact closure, regression gate, gsd-verifier, phase.complete, PROJECT.md update), and spawned the subagent for plan 01, which produced/modified packages/sdk-core/src/__tests__/folder/write-body.test.ts.

repo: packages/sdk/src/client.ts is touched by plans 02, 03, 05, 07, and 08 in phase 68.1, forcing those plans to run sequentially on the main tree (order 02→03→05→07→08) instead of in parallel waves, despite the workflow otherwise being wave/parallel-based.
Phase 68.1 is a decimal sub-phase; its close_parent_artifacts step routes to parent phase 68's UAT rather than completing an independent parent phase.
workflow: execute-phase.md orchestration pulls in a chain of reference files (gates.md, context-budget.md, execute-phase-wave-guard.md, execute-phase-context-guard.md, worktree-branch-check.md, execute-phase-between-wave-reset.md, post-merge-gate.md) before any wave execution begins — this is the standard init sequence for gsd-tools query init.execute-phase.

One plan in this phase was deliberately marked autonomous:false because its explicit job is running the full web-e2e suite, so checkpoint returns to the user are expected rather than a full autonomous run.

Flag activation for GSD workflows is determined by literal token presence in the phase context string (e.g. '68.1'), not by whether the flag is documented as available — documented flags are inert unless their exact token appears.

open_items: Waves 2 through 5 and the final gate wave (code review, regression gate, gsd-verifier, phase.complete, PROJECT.md update) had not yet run in the visible transcript — only plan 01 of Wave 1 was spawned.
The sequential client.ts dependency chain (02→03→05→07→08) may reduce the parallelism benefit of wave-based execution for this phase and could be worth flagging if it recurs.
